copy_method: Byte-for-byte complete final functional/source-notice sites and six current native opening JPEGs per case. No transformation; project guidance, raw reports, full/intermediate/state images and external reference captures excluded.

cases.runtime: Static HTML/CSS/JavaScript; browser-local shortlist and explicitly saved raw brief, prepared text and local text download. No form delivery or external service.
cases.fonts: Unchanged supplied renamed Fieldnotes Sans and Source Serif 4 subsets with complete OFL notices; the same font bytes are embedded in original SVGs.
cases.original_material: Six self-initiated fictional graphic studies, two later Offsite poster applications, study titles, marks, briefs, interface and source.
cases.composition: Compared three sketches with the same six studies. Selected unequal work wall; phone uses a deliberate single sequence. The selected study, saved identities and brief preserve their relationship.
cases.revision: Added two original Offsite applications; corrected section navigation/task entry; stacked phone Prepare/Save actions; made guide entry practical.
cases.state_contract: Opening task selects Offsite; no saved shortlist or draft. Shortlist changes save locally; explicit Save draft preserves raw fields. Preparation produces temporary reviewable text. Field or shortlist changes clear the prepared result until preparation repeats. Reset removes only this example key and keeps the selected study open.
cases.storage_contract_reference: core.js, site.js and guide.html define the example-owned storage shape and save behavior.

cases.runtime: Static HTML/CSS/JavaScript; fictional walk comparison, fixed sample duration calculation, prepared plan, explicit browser-local save and text download. No availability lookup, reservation or payment.
cases.fonts: Unmodified supplied renamed Fieldnotes Sans bytes under the filename source-sans-3.woff2, with the complete OFL notice.
cases.original_material: Fictional walk names and values, service copy, mark, page composition and source. One licensed illustrative Ali Kazal photograph is copied unchanged.
cases.composition: Compared centered postcard, bottom-edge title and compact identity within the same photograph. Selected lower-left desktop identity and separately composed tall phone scene; practical choices follow on solid surfaces.
cases.revision: Separated phone utility actions; added native phone guide jump and subordinate technical appendix; clarified the final planner stage and date guidance.
cases.state_contract: Three fixed sample walks; 1–8 walkers; Steady or Lingering pace; optional real calendar date. Each edit makes a prepared snapshot stale even if values are restored. Only a current prepared plan may save/download. Reload restores the last valid explicit save; reset clears this example key.

cases.runtime: Static HTML/CSS/JavaScript; original essay with sentence selection, browser-local notes, edit/delete/undo/reset and reload restoration. No account, upload or cloud sync.
cases.fonts: Unchanged supplied renamed Fieldnotes Sans and Source Serif 4 subsets with both complete OFL notices.
cases.original_material: Original fictional essay A seat for the unhurried city, note examples, annotation mark, product copy and source.
cases.composition: Compared compact statement over broad essay evidence, detached note beside document and statement inside the document. Selected broad essay with thought attached beneath its sentence; phone preserves reading-size prose.
cases.revision: Moved exact-passage entry beside the first instruction; restored phone guided-sample entry; narrowed desktop guide prose. A later wording correction replaced reader-facing fixture language and refreshed all four guide images.
cases.state_contract: Opening essay and no saved reader notes. Notes attach to selected passages; saved/edit/delete/undo/reset feedback stays by the active sentence. Explicit local save persists under the example key; storage failure has recovery guidance.

proofnote_final_copy_revision: Guide wording correction followed by four refreshed native guide images and independent-review supplement. Previous guide images remain under final-before-copy; only current final opening images are bundled.
licensing: Original material retains the existing candidate licensing status; no new public redistribution rights. Third-party font and photograph notices remain applicable.
